column3: Menardi has the Stars and\nyour friends. She's waiting\non the road below Imil.{end_wait}
Where? Where is Jenna!?{end_wait}
Out of your reach until\nthis is finished, and I'm\nsorry for that.{end_wait}
Sorry doesn't change\nanything. You took her from\nus.{end_wait}
Then follow us. I won't\nstop you again.{end_wait}
Wait, where's Mia? She went\nafter Menardi alone!{end_wait}
Then we'd better hurry. She\ncan't take on Menardi by\nherself!{end_wait}
...{end_wait}
She's already gone ahead.\nCome on, we have to catch\nup!{end_wait}
Menardi, I've followed you\na long way. Stop right\nthere.{end_wait}
The healer, all alone.\nCouldn't your friends keep\nup?{end_wait}
Whoever you are, please\nhelp us!{end_wait}
I will. Just stay close to\nme.{end_wait}
You lit the beacon I'm\nmeant to guard. Give them\nback, or I'll take them.{end_wait}
I don't want this fight,\nhealer, but I can't give\nthem back.{end_wait}
Then you've left me no\nchoice.{end_wait}
Enough. You have the\nadvantage. I won't risk my\nlife fighting you here.{end_wait}
But the Stars and captives\nleave with me. You cannot\nstop us.{end_wait}
Mia! Are you hurt?{end_wait}
Menardi took them all:\nJenna, Kraden, Felix and\nthe Stars.{end_wait}
Then we follow her, and\nthis time we do it\ntogether.{end_wait}
...Together, then. Just try\nto keep up.{end_wait}
